nodes.summary: Let $M$ and $N$ be Kripke models over the same atoms. A world $w$ of $M$ and a world $v$ of $N$ are bisimilar if some bisimulation between $M$ and $N$ relates $w$ to $v$.
nodes.title: Bisimilar worlds

nodes.summary: Let $M$ and $N$ be Kripke models over the same atoms, with sets of worlds $W$ and $V$ and accessibility relations $R_M$ and $R_N$. A relation $Z \subseteq W \times V$ is a bisimulation between $M$ and $N$ when, for all $w \in W$ and $v \in V$ with $w \mathrel{Z} v$: each atom $a$ is true at $w$ in $M$ if and only if $a$ is true at $v$ in $N$; for every $w'$ with $w \mathrel{R_M} w'$ there is $v'$ with…
nodes.title: Bisimulation

nodes.summary: If a world $w$ of a Kripke model $M$ and a world $v$ of a Kripke model $N$ over the same atoms are bisimilar, then every modal formula $\varphi$ is satisfied at $w$ in $M$ if and only if $\varphi$ is satisfied at $v$ in $N$.
nodes.title: Bisimilar worlds are modally equivalent

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a bisimulation between Kripke models $M$ and $N$ over the same atoms. If $Z$ relates a world $w$ of $M$ to a world $v$ of $N$, then every modal formula $\varphi$ is satisfied at $w$ in $M$ if and only if $\varphi$ is satisfied at $v$ in $N$.
nodes.title: Bisimulations preserve modal formulas

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
